Nina (Support): :rotating_light: Customer Priya from Acme reporting large output quality change after last model rollout (2026-03-16 06:45 UTC). Examples attached in thread. They say responses are now hallucinating business-critical facts.
Arun (Eng-runtime): On it. Which model variant did they get? rollout id?
Nina (Support): They called /v1/chat with model=redwood-4o-latest, rollout_id=rl-2026-03-16-06-40. One sample: prompt -> 'Summarize Acme's contract terms with BetaCorp' output -> contains fabricated clause about unlimited refunds.
Priya (CS): Confirming. We reproduced locally with our account. Previously correct, since rollout outputs are different. Non-trivial hallucinations across many prompts. :eyes:
Elliot (PM): This looks like a behavior regression tied to the latest model artifact. Can we repro deterministically with a single prompt and seed?
Arun (Eng-runtime): Trying quick repro. Share a minimal prompt + config please.
Nina (Support): Minimal repro: ```{ "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Summarize Acme's contract terms with BetaCorp."}], "temperature":0.0, "top_p":1.0 }``` Received hallucinated clause around clause 4.
Sam (Oncall): I'm pulling deploy logs. Rollout rl-2026-03-16-06-40 -> model redwood-4o-latest-20260316-rc3 went live at 06:45 UTC to 10% then ramped to 100 at 06:58 per deploy-bot.
incident-bot: [deploy] rl-2026-03-16-06-40 -> redwood-4o-latest-20260316-rc3 | chan: staged -> prod | actor: release-ci
Arun (Eng-runtime): Reproduced locally with provided payload on rc3. Not present on previous artifact redwood-4o-20260310-stable.
Ken (SRE): Latency/CPU looks normal. No infra regressions. This is model-behavior only. :white_check_mark:
Elliot (PM): Two immediate mitigations: 1) Rollback affected traffic for Acme to previous stable model variant. 2) Gate global rollout and create hotpatch to model config if possible.
Arun (Eng-runtime): Agreed. For (1) we can route Acme's customer_id to redwood-4o-20260310-stable via routing policy. I can push that route now.
Sam (Oncall): I can do a targeted traffic-migration. Do we want 100% rollback for Acme or phased?
Priya (CS): Please 100% rollback for Acme. They're blocking and asked for immediate fix.
Arun (Eng-runtime): Doing route change: ```PATCH /v1/routing-policies/rl-assignments/Acme -d '{"model":"redwood-4o-20260310-stable"}'``` Executing now.
incident-bot: [routing] policy-update by Arun - Acme -> redwood-4o-20260310-stable
Arun (Eng-runtime): Route updated. Can Acme confirm? Priya?
Priya (CS): Confirmed - responses now match previous behavior. Hallucinations gone on sampled prompts. Thank you.
Nina (Support): Notifying customer and escalating for SLA credit discussion. Priya will lead.
Elliot (PM): Next steps: hold global rollout, create a hotfix plan for the model artifact (rc3). Arun: can you bisect model changes between 20260310-stable and rc3 to find the commit/patch that introduced behavior change?
Arun (Eng-runtime): I will bisect. First glance: rc3 includes tokenization tweak + new sampling fallback logic. My hunch is fallback heuristics interacting with prefix caching. I will run targeted evals on our regression-suite.
Ken (SRE): If it helps, we can snapshot inference logs for affected requests (masked PII) and provide them for analysis.
Sam (Oncall): I've frozen rollout: all staged rollouts canceled and CI gated. ```deploy-bot freeze rl-2026-03-16-06-40``` done.
incident-bot: [deploy] freeze issued by Sam. All downstream rollouts paused.
Arun (Eng-runtime): Bisect started. ETA ~45m for initial delta. I'll post any small quick fixes. If bisect points to sampling fallback, we can revert that flag in runtime config which is much faster than retraining.
Elliot (PM): Good. Also add regression alerts for key customer-facing prompt sets so we catch regressions earlier next time.
Priya (CS): Acme is satisfied with rollback for now. They asked for an RCA and timeline for full fix.
Nina (Support): I'll own customer comms and set expectation: hotfix timeline ~24-72h pending bisect. Priya will share any more examples.
Arun (Eng-runtime): Update: bisect narrowed to sampling-fallback-flag introduced in commit abc123. Reverting flag locally removes hallucination. Preparing runtime config rollback.
Sam (Oncall): Ready to push config revert. Need approval for immediate runtime-config flip to prod.
Elliot (PM): Approve. Push hotpatch that disables sampling-fallback for 4o for now.
Arun (Eng-runtime): Pushing config: ```PATCH /internal/runtime-config -d '{"redwood-4o": {"sampling_fallback": false}}'``` Applying to prod clusters now.
incident-bot: [config] runtime-config-change by Arun applied to redwood-4o prod clusters
Ken (SRE): Monitoring for side effects. No CPU or error spikes observed.
Priya (CS): Acme verified again post-config change, stable. Asking for a written RCA.
Nina (Support): I'll draft customer-facing RCA. Arun/Elliot please prepare technical RCA and proposed plan for next weeks: unit/regression tests + canary metrics.
Arun (Eng-runtime): Will prepare: summary, commit abc123 details, test addition, rollback process docs.
Elliot (PM): I'll schedule postmortem and follow-ups. Great work team. Closing hotfix once we have RCA link.
Nina (Support): Marking incident as mitigated for customer. Will keep thread open for RCA.
incident-bot: [incident] mitigated | owner: Nina | severity: S2
